lines.speaker: Lena Park
lines.text: You're not from around here, yet you know my name. You're a police officer, aren't you?

lines.speaker: Lena Park
lines.text: Then what do you need to know?

lines.speaker: Lena Park
lines.text: He was a good man. Responsible and optimistic.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: Have you had any contact with him recently?

lines.speaker: Lena Park
lines.text: We would occasionally run into each other on the street. I only introduced him to some of the new components I had in stock.

lines.speaker: Lena Park
lines.text: I noticed that his NeuroLink was outdated. It could affect his nervous system, so I advised him to come to my shop and have it replaced. But he never came here.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: Did he show any unusual behavior recently?

lines.speaker: Lena Park
lines.text: I'm not sure. But just by looking at his NeuroLink, I could tell that he might eventually develop memory problems.

lines.speaker: Lena Park
lines.text: Old components can affect memory and the brain's processing speed.

lines.speaker: Lena Park
lines.text: His work also frequently involved electrical equipment. Even a small electrical current could have a serious impact on his brain.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: How could such a small electrical current have that kind of effect?

lines.speaker: Lena Park
lines.text: I've been selling cybernetic components for years. I can recognize it just by looking at the hardware.

lines.speaker: Lena Park
lines.text: His NeuroLink was an outdated model, and it was already very old. Its load tolerance was extremely low, making it highly susceptible to burning out or even exploding, even under a weak electrical current.

lines.speaker: Lena Park
lines.text: That's why I would often recommend newer components to him whenever we met.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: That's very useful information. Thank you, Ms. Lena.
